svg.title: Branches as a draft copy of the menu board
svg.desc: Main is the menu on the wall with commits Add menu, Add hours, Merge cold coffee, Add photos. A cold-coffee draft branch splits off after Add hours with commits Add cold coffee and Price it at 180, then merges back. Steps: 1 make a draft copy with git checkout -b cold-coffee, 2 commit on the draft while the wall menu does not change, 3 put it on the wall with git merge cold-coffee.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Branches: work on a draft copy, keep main safe

text.tspan: Customers order from the wall menu all day, so nobody
scribbles on it. You change a draft on paper, and the
wall is updated only once the owner approves it.

text.tspan: • branch = a separate line of work
• commits on it never touch main
• merge = bring its commits into main
• 📍 HEAD = the branch you're on now
